facts.name: No personal statement/SOP required for MS CS
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements. Achsah confirms CSUF does not require a personal statement/SOP for the MS Computer Science program. Also lists letters of recommendation, resumes, and GRE/GMAT as not required.
facts.quote: Please do not submit any of the following items as they are not required for admission: Personal Statements Letter of Recommendations High School Transcripts Certificates of Accomplishments / Trainings Resumes / Work Experience GRE or GMAT Scores

facts.name: Official documents and ELP scores before document deadlines
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements.
facts.quote: Official documents and required English Language Proficiency test scores must be submitted and processed before document deadlines.

facts.name: 30 units for ECS master's programs
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements. Applies to all ECS master's programs.
facts.quote: All of the master's programs require 30 units to receive your degree.

facts.name: International students must stay full-time
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements.
facts.quote: International students must maintain their full-time student status.

facts.name: F-1 applicants and online programs
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements.
facts.quote: Students seeking an F1 Visa are not currently eligible to apply for online graduate programs.

facts.name: No application fee waiver
facts.detail: ECS college graduate admissions page, which Achsah confirms governs CS-specific requirements.
facts.quote: An application fee waiver is not available.

facts.name: University minimum GPA 2.5
facts.detail: Office of Graduate Studies, institution-wide baseline requirement that applies alongside the CS-specific list above (not in conflict; general eligibility floor, not a materials requirement).
facts.quote: University requirements include having a minimum GPA of 2.5 (cumulative or last 60 semester GPA units), a bachelor’s degree from an institutionally accredited college or university, and good standing with the last attended institution.

facts.name: 4-year degree or equivalent
facts.detail: Office of Graduate Studies, institution-wide baseline requirement that applies alongside the CS-specific list above. 3-year degrees may use a WES/IEE equivalency report.
facts.quote: CSUF will only accept 4-year degrees or equivalent.

facts.name: English Language Proficiency test for non-US attendees
facts.detail: Office of Graduate Studies, institution-wide baseline requirement that applies alongside the CS-specific list above. Duolingo accepted.
facts.quote: Students who attended a university outside of the United States and do not qualify for a waiver must take an English Language Proficiency (ELP) test

facts.name: One program per campus per semester
facts.detail: Office of Graduate Studies, institution-wide baseline requirement that applies alongside the CS-specific list above.
facts.quote: You can only apply to one program per campus, for a given semester.

facts.name: No deferral of admission
facts.detail: Office of Graduate Studies, institution-wide baseline requirement that applies alongside the CS-specific list above.
facts.quote: Please note, students cannot defer their admissions.
